candidates.comment: A building or site used for religious worship, such as a mosque, church, temple, or synagogue. Also called house of worship, religious site, shrine, sanctuary. Examples: the al-Aqsa mosque compound.

candidates.label: Synagogue
candidates.comment: A Jewish place of worship. Also called shul, temple (Jewish).

candidates.label: Church
candidates.comment: A Christian place of worship. Also called chapel, cathedral, parish church.

candidates.label: Mosque
candidates.comment: A Muslim place of worship. Also called masjid, Islamic house of worship. Examples: the al-Aqsa Mosque.

candidates.label: MusicGroup
candidates.comment: A band or ensemble of musicians performing together. Also called band, group, ensemble, act.

candidates.label: PeopleAudience
candidates.comment: An audience defined by characteristics of people. Also called target demographic.

candidates.label: DanceGroup
candidates.comment: A troupe of dancers performing together. Also called dance troupe, dance company, ensemble.

candidates.label: PerformingGroup
candidates.comment: A group that performs together, such as a band or circus. Also called troupe, ensemble, company.

candidates.label: SizeGroupEnumeration
candidates.comment: An enumeration of product size groups. Also called size group.

candidates.label: NewsMediaOrganization
candidates.comment: A news or media organisation that gathers and publishes news, such as a newspaper, news agency, broadcaster, or TV station. Also called news outlet, media company, press organisation, broadcaster, wire service. Examples: the BBC, National News Agency (NNA), Reuters.

candidates.label: Organization
candidates.comment: An organised body of people with a particular purpose: a company, institution, association, agency, club, or government body. Also called institution, body, agency, group, establishment.

candidates.label: RadioStation
candidates.comment: An organisation that broadcasts radio. Also called radio broadcaster, radio channel.

candidates.label: SearchRescueOrganization
candidates.comment: An organisation that conducts search and rescue. Also called SAR organisation, rescue service.

candidates.label: SportsOrganization
candidates.comment: An organisation that governs or runs a sport or sporting competition. Also called sporting body, league, federation.
